correctness.rationale: The REPAIRED final theorem is the singular low-rate Bernoulli crossover, NOT the earlier full set of conditional Gumbel/geometric claims. With z=kappa a and L=kappa m->u>0, killed-interval first-exit probabilities are A=sinh(L-z)/sinh L, B=sinh z/sinh L; half-line absorption-without-reset p=e^-z. Exact renewal gives P(M>m)=B/(A+B), P(N=0,M>m)=p-A. Expanding yields A=1-z coth u+o(z), B=z csch u+o(z), p=1-z+o(z), and hence conditional zero-reset e^-u; P(N>=2|M>m)<=q²/P(M>m)=O(z), so the remaining mass tends to one reset. At fixed r>0 p-A=O(e^-2L), tail is Theta(e^-L), proving noncommuting limits. Independent numerical substitution with u=2, r from 1 to 1e-4 confirms convergence but analytic bound proves the result.
